subject: SIG / SOC2 / ISO questions: cryptographic governance & data residency mapping
messages:
From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@adeptfin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adept Fin Security <security@adeptfin.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 13:42:00 -0400
Subject: SIG tail: follow-up on crypto questions and residency mapping

Mina — thanks for taking this on. A couple of items bubbled up from our SIG review that require more granular evidence than the high-level control descriptions you already provided. Can you help with the following?

1) Key custody and separation of duties: who has administrative access to KMS vs. operational keys in HSMs? We need a diagram and a short matrix mapping roles to allowed actions (create/rotate/export/decommission).

2) Rotation & entropy: current description says "automated rotation" — what is the rotation cadence per key type (root/intermediate/data keys)? Any third-party KMS/HSM vendor details and FIPS 140 validation reports would help.

3) Data residency boundary: we need a CSV that maps customer regions to storage locations, and a short note on cross-border replicated backups and whether any customer data leaves the region for processing.

4) Audit samples: can you provide 2–3 log samples showing KMS access events and a sample key-rotation audit entry? Redacted is fine.

We'd like to get these by EOD Monday so we can finish the SIG assessment. Happy to hop on a quick screen share if that helps.

Thanks,
Claire
Security Program Manager
Adept Financial

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@adeptfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG tail: follow-up on crypto questions and residency mapping

Claire — appreciate the clear list. Quick plan below and attachments I will upload to the shared folder: redwood_key_rotation_policy_v1.3.pdf (policy + cadence table), kms-audit-sample-202712.zip (redacted logs), data-residency-boundary-map.csv (mapping CSV).

Answers in brief:
- Key custody: platform ops (2 people in IAM group) have KMS admin for provisioning only; HSMs are in a separate team (Hardware Security) with dual-approval for export/decommission. We will include a role-action matrix and a simple custody diagram.
- Rotation cadence: root/master keys: 36 months (manual rotate with rotation ceremony); intermediate/KMS-wrapped keys: 12 months; per-customer data encryption keys (DEKs): default 90 days with automatic rewrap.
- Vendor/FIPS: we use CloudVault KMS (multi-region) + Thales nShield HSM at critical nodes; both claim FIPS 140-2 Level 3 — we will attach vendor validation links and our supplier attestations.
- Cross-border backups: backups are region-pinned by default; we replicate to a paired region within the same geopolitical block for DR (e.g., us-east -> us-west). No processing of customer content is performed outside customer-designated region unless explicitly enabled in account settings; that setting is surfaced in the Console and logged.

Ask: Aditya — can you prepare the custody diagram and the role-action matrix? Kimberly — please pull the vendor FIPS statements and the redaction-friendly rotation audit sample. I will stage the CSV and policy.

Mina
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_key_rotation_policy_v1.3.pdf (policy), data-residency-boundary-map.csv (mapping)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG tail: follow-up on crypto questions and residency mapping

Team — I put together a concise custody matrix and diagram and uploaded both to the evidence folder (link below). Key points to call out for Adept:
- Admin vs. crypto ops separation: IAM admins can create KMS aliases but cannot export key material; HSM operators hold the offline key-custody tokens and require dual sign-off for any HSM export.
- Emergency access: 'break-glass' is logged and requires 2 leaders approval plus immediate after-action audit.

Attached artifacts (stubs):
- custody-matrix.png (role -> action mapping)
- key-custody-diagram.svg (flow of keys across runtime, persistent storage, backups)

Small note for legal: Monica, there is a single sentence in our supplier attestation that references a third-party subprocessor for backup transit — we should confirm whether that requires an explicit customer-facing disclosure for Adept before they classify as "no cross-border processing."

Aditya
Director, Applied Security Operations

Attachments: custody-matrix.png, key-custody-diagram.svg
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-key-evidence

From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@adeptfin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adept Fin Security <security@adeptfin.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 12:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG tail: follow-up on crypto questions and residency mapping

Mina / Aditya — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple of follow-ups after an internal read:
- Could you include a short sample of the rotation ceremony checklist for root key rotates? We want to see the approvals track and the measures taken to verify zero-downtime migrations.
- The supplier attestation sentence flagged by Monica: can you confirm whether the subprocessor is used for cross-region transit only during DR tests or for routine replication? If the former, we can accept a statement that it is DR-only.
- We will accept redacted audit samples; please remove any customer identifiers beyond account-id hashes.

If you can get these three small items by Monday EOD we'll mark the SIG "clarifications satisfied" and proceed to the control scoring stage.

Thanks,
Claire

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@adeptfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 09:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG tail: follow-up on crypto questions and residency mapping

Claire — quick confirmation:
- Rotation ceremony checklist: attached as an excerpt (rotation-ceremony-checklist.txt). It includes sign-off fields, smoke-test steps, and an explicit rollback pathway.
- Subprocessor use: Monica confirmed the subprocessor is engaged only for cross-region transit during scheduled DR exercises, not for routine replication. I've attached Monica's attestation note (monica_dr_attestation.txt) and we will update the supplier attestation doc accordingly.
- Audit logs: shipped 3 redacted event samples in kms-audit-sample-202712.zip (all account IDs hashed, workspace names removed).

I'll drop the final evidence bundle into the Drive folder and send you a HubSpot update (ADEPT-2042). If anything else pops up, ping me and we can schedule a 30-min call next week.

Best,
Mina

Attachments: rotation-ceremony-checklist.txt, monica_dr_attestation.txt, kms-audit-sample-202712.zip
